historical_model_estimate: one-step-ahead Kalman prediction from the current-origin fitted support-preserving CPD+ERP model; not an archived forecast issued on each historical date
historical_baseline_estimate: one-step-ahead Kalman prediction from the separately fitted Forecast 1 model with no CPD or ERP inputs, using the same current origin
cpd_scope_warning: CPD proposal acceptance uses synthetic truth in this QA/demo bundle; it is not a production CPD acceptance policy.
aggregate_interval_method: Monte Carlo sum after independently pairing draws from the four restaurant posterior marginals
aggregate_interval_caveat: Cross-restaurant posterior dependence is not identified by the four separate Forecast fits and is not represented in these combined bands.
change_since_previous_forecast_status: withheld: the prior origin does not overlap enough of the current 14-day horizon for a fair comparison
